properties.statement: Q-2/Q-8: an enums block loads iff values are unique within each enum (no constraint on the values themselves, so 0 and negatives load); a duplicate is enum_duplicate_value.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (es : Esm.Closed.Enums.EnumsBlock), (Esm.Closed.Enums.validateEnums es = Except.ok () ↔ ∀ e ∈ es, (List.map Prod.snd e.2).Nodup) ∧ ((∃ e ∈ es, ¬(List.map Prod.snd e.2).Nodup) → Esm.Closed.Enums.validateEnums es = Except.error "enum_duplicate_value")
∀ (n₁ n₂ : String) (m₁ m₂ : Esm.Closed.Enums.Enum), (List.map Prod.snd m₁).Nodup → (List.map Prod.snd m₂).Nodup → Esm.Closed.Enums.validateEnums [(n₁, m₁), (n₂, m₂)] = Except.ok ()

properties.statement: An enum op resolves to exactly its declared integer (zero and negatives included; no clamping or defaulting).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (es : Esm.Closed.Enums.EnumsBlock) (name sym : String) (m : Esm.Closed.Enums.Enum) (v : ℤ), List.lookup name es = Option.some m → List.lookup sym m = Option.some v → Esm.Closed.Enums.resolve es name sym = Except.ok v

properties.statement: An undeclared enum is unknown_enum, an undeclared symbol unknown_enum_symbol.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (es : Esm.Closed.Enums.EnumsBlock) (name sym : String), (List.lookup name es = Option.none → Esm.Closed.Enums.resolve es name sym = Except.error "unknown_enum") ∧ ∀ (m : Esm.Closed.Enums.Enum), List.lookup name es = Option.some m → List.lookup sym m = Option.none → Esm.Closed.Enums.resolve es name sym = Except.error "unknown_enum_symbol"
